searchText: I'm looking at a consensus split that occurs between geth/besu when running a local devnet. It appears in my case that calling `0x00..000` within a transaction creation context does not result in a read of that account for besu while it does for geth. at least... I'm fairly sure this is what's happening based on a stack trace. unfortunately the opcode-level tracing is not yet working in geth's BAL implementation this is my kurtosis config: https://gist.github.com/jwasinger/4d5a5a1c45254e3034a9e3cb0bf4e1e9 . run `make run-registry` to spin up the devnet. I can also send the block history directly if desired. it's only around 330 blocks, so not too large.
